issue_request: FHIR-6064 was Published/Persuasive for DSTU1 and requested RiskAssessment as an allowed resource for ClinicalImpression.investigations.item and as a target for prognosis.
initial_application: RiskAssessment was added to ClinicalImpression.investigations.item in ca8df34006df02f9b2a896eaf41a72e1d418fe9d, immediately before the Jira-commented SVN #9058 commit. Commit 127b8fa2717d9a7b08169daaf955d8a9c3ec9aa5 included #6064 and added ClinicalImpression.prognosisReference as Reference(RiskAssessment).
additional_context: FHIR-18860 later removed ClinicalImpression.investigation and clarified supportingInfo as the broad Reference(Any) location for investigation results. FHIR-46596 renamed ClinicalImpression to ClinicalAssessment, and FHIR-50412 collapsed prognosis into a CodeableReference that still targets RiskAssessment. Commit fad1b9cf84ef652e88947e1a13b026c62f95334e removed ClinicalAssessment from active fhir.ini build-scope lists, leaving both ClinicalImpression and ClinicalAssessment folders inactive in this checkout.
reconciliation: No source file was changed. The inactive ClinicalImpression and ClinicalAssessment sources already preserve the RiskAssessment prognosis semantics and broad supportingInfo/investigation-result support, while the active build has no ClinicalImpression or ClinicalAssessment resource entry to correct.
